documentation_excerpts.text: It is the companion data layer for Stock-Grader; every dataset ships with a manifest.json (schema version, source URLs, fetch timestamp, sha256, row counts, license note) so downstream consumers can verify what they are reading.

The daily symbol-directory snapshot is the point-in-time universe archive: each day's diff is a free listing/delisting/ticker-change event stream. […] The archive only covers dates after the archiver started — which is why it runs first.
